compatibility_assessment.status: Conditional concept hypothesis; neither compatibility nor an unavoidable conflict established
compatibility_assessment.concept: Place the exposed spine and equipment above the upper rotor. Suspend a stationary outboard fork from an overhead cross-member. Bearing-supported outer and inner gimbal members surround a carrier between the rotor planes; both motors and rotors belong to the same inner moving group. Keep descending supports and landing legs outside the assessed rotor motion envelopes.
compatibility_assessment.load_path: Motor mounts to common carrier to inner trunnions/bearings to outer gimbal to outer trunnions/bearings to suspended fork to overhead cross-member and spine. Landing loads return through outboard legs and the fixed structure.
important_risks: A support or harness routed through a rotating blade annulus is not acceptable merely because it is near the module axis.
Outboard support width, moving-carrier inertia, bearing loads and servo torque may make an otherwise clear layout impractical.
Servo output shafts are not assumed to carry primary propulsion structural loads.
Two opposite-facing motors and their adapters require confirmed upward-thrust propeller installation; upper/lower labels do not establish handedness or spin signs.
compatibility_assessment.escalation: Report established conflicts to Chief before changing actuation. Neither alternative changes the retained common two-axis gimbal.
compatibility_assessment.chief_notification_status: This file is not evidence that a progress message was delivered.

units_and_frames.gimbal_rotation: R_BM = Rx(alpha) * Ry(beta); inner axis is carried by outer rotation

units_and_frames.inertia_conversion: I_solid_kg_m2 = density_kg_m3 * I_solid_geometric_mm5 * 1e-15; aggregate with the parallel-axis theorem and rotate the full tensor with R_BC
units_and_frames.inertia_warning: The factor for inertia already expressed in kg mm^2 is 1e-6, not 1e-15. Preserve reference point and axes.

foot_contact_interface.geometry: Proposed spherical foot screening surface, radius 12 mm, centres given per alternative; lowest neutral point lies at Z_C=0
foot_contact_interface.membership: Fixed airframe for rigid nominal geometry
foot_contact_interface.compression_coordinate: Optional independent c_i in metres, positive retraction toward +Z_C; foot-centre displacement [0,0,1000*c_i] mm. This is a kinematic sensitivity, not a spring/damper or validated leg design.
foot_contact_interface.contact_evaluation: Use the minimum world-ground gap of each transformed foot surface; the contacting surface point, not merely its centre, defines contacting-foot velocity.
foot_contact_interface.required_kinematics: Provide configuration-dependent position and Jacobians. Plant conversion from instantaneous CG must include moving-CG offset derivatives and body angular velocity; compressed-foot velocity additionally includes c_i_dot.
foot_contact_interface.limits_status: Future simulation targets, not CAD passes or approval of this contact model

measurement_and_verification_plan.native_and_step: Save both formats, hash and reopen actual files, enumerate and measure individual solids. Never read CenterOfMass or MatrixOfInertia from generic Part.Shape/Part.Compound.
measurement_and_verification_plan.native_editability: Probe controlling dimensional and joint parameters on reopened native files, recompute, measure response and restore without saving; distinguish native editability from STEP geometry-only export.
measurement_and_verification_plan.motion_sampling: Start with a 2.5-degree grid spanning each full joint rectangle, including endpoints and simultaneous extrema. Record every tested configuration and the limiting pairs. Refine near minima; sampled minima are not continuous-domain proof.
required_collision_categories: each rotor versus outboard legs and feet
each rotor versus all equipment placeholders
each rotor versus moving nonrotating support
measurement_and_verification_plan.intended_interfaces: Maintain an explicit pair register for intended bearing/mount contact. Do not silently exempt an entire support or rotor disk because a hub connection exists.
measurement_and_verification_plan.upright_ground: Evaluate both actual transformed swept-envelope solids against nominal level ground throughout the assessed joint domain, separately from structural clearances.
measurement_and_verification_plan.attitude_sensitivity: Evaluate upright and a 5-degree total airframe tilt cone across azimuth; do not substitute simultaneous 5-degree roll and pitch for the agreed 5-degree total tilt. Include a separately labelled 10-degree off-nominal sensitivity.
measurement_and_verification_plan.ground_placement: For each attitude/compression sample translate the rigid assembly to first foot contact on level ground, then compute both rotor gaps. Settling compression cases are kinematic scenarios, not a dynamic landing solution.
measurement_and_verification_plan.continuous_bounds: Retain conservative rigid-envelope bounds independently of sampled OCCT distances. For axis-aligned local rotor slabs with centre offset d along the module axis, radius R and half-thickness h, vertical extrema relative to pivot are d*n_z +/- (R*sqrt(1-n_z^2)+h*abs(n_z)). Bound the complete declared angular domain, not only its corners. Geometry-to-geometry bounds must include both objects' motions.
measurement_and_verification_plan.clearance_conclusion_rule: A positive rigid-model gap does not establish physical safety while allowances remain unresolved.
measurement_and_verification_plan.artifact_bound_checker: Retain an editable checker. Its verify_command inputs must include every tested artifact Ref; stdout contains only VerificationResult JSON and diagnostics go to stderr.
measurement_and_verification_plan.cad_execution: Saved scripts through freecad_run(headless=true), with every generated native, STEP, drawing and measurement export declared in outputs
measurement_and_verification_plan.acceptance: No fabrication release, PID tuning, mission validation or review acceptance

concrete_interface_needs: Propulsion: confirm exact candidate variants, installation masses and accessory inclusion; provide controller/sensor/receiver/supply/harness envelopes and ledger IDs.
Chief/human: disposition of exploratory geometry/travel after measured comparisons; resolve any established common-gimbal compatibility conflict before concept changes.
Mounting evidence: motor hole patterns and adapters; servo output axes, horns and ears; bearing dimensions/loads; positive retention and wiring routes.
Plant: consume candidate-tagged pivots, thrust points, foot surfaces and moving groups as exploratory interfaces only; do not create selected vehicle defaults from these hypotheses.
Later physical evidence: loaded blade envelope, structural and landing deflections, bearing play, manufacturing allowances and actuator capability.
